desc: 插在墙插上的立式诱捕器，肩口泛冷光引导飞行动线，弧面挡板收住内芯
name: 插电立式冷光常驻诱捕器款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清产品形态：立式插墙、弧面外壳、卡匣在上，赢下第一点击。
一秒讲清引导、收纳、遮蔽三段机制，把主图升级成卖点图。
放大傍晚厨房台面旁的飞行动线困扰，让用户认出自家场景。
把产品放进真实夜间的墙插位置，让人代入自己家的那面墙。
用同机位双栏对照说明外壳一遮一露的差别，把遮蔽卖点视觉化。
用四行空白图标栏回答它针对什么对象，替代原文案清单。
用卡口与接缝微距证明装配工艺，把结构讲实。
一屏交代同技术不同体型的三挡位选择，替用户做规格决策。
用平铺清单和留空参数栏消除到货与规格风险，不搬任何资质数字。
以换装动作收口，引导把补充装一起带走，完成最后一屏转化。

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, cobalt-blue #1B4FD8 and deep navy #16307A panels for benefit and info screens, dim plum-violet #2A2140 for night ambience, white subway tile #F2F4F6 for in-home walls
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular icon nodes with hairline leader lines, single violet accent #6B3FC4, abstract glyphs only
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K key with soft fill, a tight cool glow #2E63D8 pooling around the product shoulder, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-tech home pest-control visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cobalt blue #1B4FD8, deep navy #16307A, violet accent #6B3FC4 and charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool 6000K key light with soft fill and a tight cool glow #2E63D8 pooling around the product shoulder, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with every headline and label reduced to blank bars and empty grid rows; thin-line circular icon nodes in one violet accent; the upright product shown at a stable slight 3/4 angle and constant scale; clean high-end home-care product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no realistic insects.
noDrift: no realistic insects or pest carcasses
no rendered brand marks, badges or numerals
style.presentationRules: the upright unit keeps one vertical stance, the same slight 3/4 hero angle and a constant scale across the whole set; the shoulder glow always reads as one soft halo
style.surfaceSystem: glossy white subway tile #F2F4F6 and matte light-stone counter #E9E4DD
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all in-image copy stripped, headlines and labels carried by blank bars and empty grid rows only
